scope: Offline synthetic motor and housing plant with one bounded cooling grant per mission and a single-writer charging coordination fixture

coverage: first effect, expired reservation, exact boost end and elapsed-clock boundaries
operator veto and local protection before and after grant
pending or active cooling versus diversion and selected diversion versus new cooling
Phase 4 station and departure freshness, approval, and route eligibility
spent grant and operator veto across journal reopen

preserved_development_findings: An initial incremental plant calculation used the state transition in the wrong orientation. The corrected calculation agrees with the frozen thermal model's batch rollout.

The first valid whole-mission effect measurement combined pump cooling with independent local load reduction. The pre-freeze scoring design now holds the load-reduction schedule fixed for the isolated effect and reports the full mission comparison separately.
limits: Forecast coverage is empirical for overlapping samples on these synthetic trajectories.
The motor bench model does not supply bus thermal parameters or commands.

Charging interaction is verified at an offline simulated actuator boundary with the existing Phase 4 admission guard. Live service coordination, hardware calibration and vehicle actuation remain unqualified.
